title: Fun   Christmas light tour on the TukTuk
text: Loved that it was a small  group tour and it was easy to meet up   and very comfortable - our tour guide Lucca was very knowledgeable   and friendly !
author: Linda_K

title: Great.
text: Nice way to discover the illuminations of Barcelona at the end of the day, in 1 hour, a tour of the central streets illuminated without tiring
author: Traveler41283127359

title: Fun, easy and so pretty!
text: Diana and Amanda were wonderful guides! We saw so many different holiday light displays and they were very knowledgeable about the history of the city, and gave us lots of interesting info about the light installations. This was a fun and easy way to see lots of lights in a short time!
author: Jordyn_Z

title: Great way to see Christmas lights in Barcelona!
text: Our Christmas lights tuk tuk tour was a wonderful way to enjoy the holiday season. We had just arrived in Barcelona that morning and wanted to do something easy and fun in the evening. It was a holiday weekend so traffic was very busy and slow, but our tour guide Jose did a nice job of showing the lights and talking about Barcelona.
author: Richard_D

title: Just Do It
text: We loved it. Our tour guide was fun and engaging. It’s a fantastic way to take a tour. We toured the Barcelona Christmas lights.
author: Jane_A

title: Amazing time!!
text:
Our guide Itene was knowledgable and very friendly. We had as much fun talking with her as we did seeing the lights. 

Also the company wss so flexible and understanding allowing us to reschedule because of some teavel delays.
author: Patrick_S

title: Best Christmas lights tour in Barcelona!
text:
Amazing experience and super Christmas, we loved it! It was a different, comfortable and super nice way to tour the city at night, seeing all the decorated streets and the illuminated buildings. Barcelona at Christmas is already beautiful, but living it like this makes it even more special. 

Our guide was super friendly and told us curiosities as we passed by the most beautiful spots. The ride was comfortable, safe and very fun. 

I recommend this tour 100% if you want to live the Christmas spirit in a different and unique way. We did it as a family but it is also perfect to enjoy as a couple
author: 822inesc

title: Really fun
text: We loved our light tour experience it was really fun our guide was great really knowledgeable and funny

title: Totally worth it!
text: Our guide/driver, Yaros, was friendly, knowledgeable, and funny!  The one hour tour was filled with fun facts, with glittery lights of Plaza Catalunya, Passeig de Gracia, and Columbus Monument.  We will do
